title: RLS JSON Cache
tag_line: Caches vehicle and RLS data files in memory so they are not re-read from disk
message:
[b]Xetius’s RLS JSON Cache[/b]

This mod keeps frequently re-read JSON files in memory so BeamNG and RLS Career Overhaul stop reading them from disk multiple times.

[b]What it caches[/b]
[list]
[*]Vehicle info files ([i]info*.json[/i]) and configurations ([i]*.pc[/i]), which BeamNG re-reads every time it rebuilds its vehicle list (entering garage mode, saving a configuration etc.)
[*]RLS Street Knights venue files, which RLS re-scans many, many times per session
[/list]

[b]Results[/b]
[list]
[*]Vehicle list rebuild: about 2.5 s down to 0.5 s with the cache filled
[*]RLS Street Knights and vehicle value lookups: about 90% faster
[*]Memory: about 25 MB with a large mod list
[/list]

[b]Safe by design[/b]
[list]
[*]Save files and part (.jbeam) files are never cached
[*]Every read returns a fresh copy, so nothing can change the cached data
[*]Entries are dropped when the file is written or changed, and the whole cache clears when mods are enabled or disabled
[/list]

[b]Console Commands (GE Lua)[/b]
[list]
[*][i]xRlsCache.stats()[/i] shows hits, misses and memory use
[*][i]xRlsCache.setEnabled(false)[/i] turns caching off
[*][i]xRlsCache.clear()[/i] empties the cache
[/list]
